SELECT s.name,

       CASE
         WHEN AVG(c."convertedManaCost") < 3 THEN 'Aggro'
         WHEN AVG(c."convertedManaCost") > 4 THEN 'Control'
         ELSE 'Midrange'
       END AS tempo_archetype
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setCode" = s."code"
WHERE s.releaseDate > '2015-01-01'

  AND c.type NOT LIKE '%Land%'
GROUP BY s.code;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.name AS card_name,
       s.name AS set_name,
       NULL AS tier
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
    AND l.format = 'standard'
    AND l.status = 'Legal'
WHERE c.convertedManaCost <= 4
  AND (
        (c.flavorText IS NOT NULL AND lower(c.flavorText) LIKE '%justice%')
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM foreign_data fd
            WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
              AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
              AND lower(fd.flavorText) LIKE '%justice%'
        )
      );

SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS name, s.name AS set_name, NULL AS competitive_tier
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.convertedManaCost <= 4
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "legalities" l 
    WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.format = 'standard' AND l.status = 'Legal'
  )
  AND (
    c.flavorText LIKE '%justice%' COLLATE NOCASE
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "foreign_data" fd 
      WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid AND fd.flavorText LIKE '%justice%' COLLATE NOCASE
    )
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS card_name,
       s.name AS set_name,
       NULL AS competitive_tier
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE l.format = 'standard'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.convertedManaCost <= 4
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd
        WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
          AND LOWER(fd.flavorText) LIKE '%justice%'
      );

votes.sql:
WITH cards_legal_commander AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.setCode, c.edhrecRank
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
    WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
),
cards_with_tier AS (
    SELECT uuid, setCode,
           CASE 
               WHEN edhrecRank <= 100 THEN 'Tier 1'
               WHEN edhrecRank > 100 AND edhrecRank <= 250 THEN 'Tier 2'
               WHEN edhrecRank > 250 THEN 'Tier 3'
           END AS tier
    FROM cards_legal_commander
    WHERE edhrecRank IS NOT NULL
),
set_totals AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS total_cards
    FROM cards_legal_commander
    GROUP BY setCode
),
tier_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, tier, COUNT(*) AS tier_count
    FROM cards_with_tier
    GROUP BY setCode, tier
),
proportions AS (
    SELECT t.setCode, s.name AS set_name, t.tier, 
           (t.tier_count * 1.0 / st.total_cards) AS proportion
    FROM tier_counts t
    INNER JOIN set_totals st ON t.setCode = st.setCode
    INNER JOIN sets s ON t.setCode = s.code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT set_name, tier, proportion,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY proportion DESC) AS rn
    FROM proportions
)
SELECT set_name, tier, proportion
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY tier, rn;

WITH commander_cards AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.setCode, c.tier
    FROM cards c
    JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
),
set_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.code AS set_code,
        s.name AS set_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cc.tier = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cc.tier = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cc.tier = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS t3
    FROM commander_cards cc
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = cc.setCode
    GROUP BY s.code, s.name
),
proportions AS (
    SELECT
        set_code,
        set_name,
        CASE WHEN total>0 THEN t1*1.0/total END AS prop1,
        CASE WHEN total>0 THEN t2*1.0/total END AS prop2,
        CASE WHEN total>0 THEN t3*1.0/total END AS prop3
    FROM set_stats
),
unpivot AS (
    SELECT set_code, set_name, prop1 AS proportion, 'Tier1' AS tier FROM proportions WHERE prop1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT set_code, set_name, prop2, 'Tier2' FROM proportions WHERE prop2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT set_code, set_name, prop3, 'Tier3' FROM proportions WHERE prop3 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY proportion DESC) AS rn
    FROM unpivot
)
SELECT set_code, set_name, proportion, tier
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY tier, proportion DESC;

SELECT
    name,
    (
        (COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(power, '') AS REAL), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(toughness, '') AS REAL), 0))
        / COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 1)
    )
    + (CASE WHEN keywords IS NULL OR trim(keywords) = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (length(keywords) - length(replace(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
       END) * 0.5
    + (CASE rarity
            WHEN 'common'   THEN 1
            WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
            WHEN 'rare'     THEN 3
            WHEN 'mythic'   THEN 4
            ELSE 0
       END) * 0.3 AS rating,
    CASE
        WHEN (
                (COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(power, '') AS REAL), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(toughness, '') AS REAL), 0))
                / COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 1)
            )
            + (CASE WHEN keywords IS NULL OR trim(keywords) = '' THEN 0
                    ELSE (length(keywords) - length(replace(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
               END) * 0.5
            + (CASE rarity
                    WHEN 'common'   THEN 1
                    WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'rare'     THEN 3
                    WHEN 'mythic'   THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
               END) * 0.3 < 2
            THEN 'Beginner'
        WHEN (
                (COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(power, '') AS REAL), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(toughness, '') AS REAL), 0))
                / COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 1)
            )
            + (CASE WHEN keywords IS NULL OR trim(keywords) = '' THEN 0
                    ELSE (length(keywords) - length(replace(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
               END) * 0.5
            + (CASE rarity
                    WHEN 'common'   THEN 1
                    WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'rare'     THEN 3
                    WHEN 'mythic'   THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
               END) * 0.3 < 4
            THEN 'Intermediate'
        ELSE 'Expert'
    END AS tier
FROM cards
WHERE type LIKE '%Legendary%' AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
ORDER BY rating DESC;

WITH legendary_creatures AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        name,
        power,
        toughness,
        convertedManaCost,
        keywords,
        rarity
    FROM cards
    WHERE supertypes LIKE '%Legendary%'
      AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
),
card_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        name,
        COALESCE(
            CASE 
                WHEN power REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(power AS REAL)
                ELSE 0
            END,
        0) AS power_value,
        COALESCE(
            CASE 
                WHEN toughness REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(toughness AS REAL)
                ELSE 0
            END,
        0) AS toughness_value,
        COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 0) AS cmc,
        CASE 
            WHEN keywords IS NULL OR keywords = '' THEN 0
            ELSE LENGTH(keywords) - LENGTH(REPLACE(keywords, ',', '')) + 1
        END AS keyword_count,
        CASE rarity
            WHEN 'mythic rare' THEN 4.0
            WHEN 'rare' THEN 3.0
            WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2.0
            WHEN 'common' THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.5
        END AS rarity_multiplier
    FROM legendary_creatures
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        ((power_value + toughness_value) / NULLIF(cmc, 0) * keyword_count * rarity_multiplier), 2
    ) AS viability_rating,
    CASE 
        WHEN (power_value + toughness_value) / NULLIF(cmc, 0) * keyword_count * rarity_multiplier < 8.0 THEN 'beginner-friendly'
        WHEN (power_value + toughness_value) / NULLIF(cmc, 0) * keyword_count * rarity_multiplier < 25.0 THEN 'intermediate'
        ELSE 'expert-level'
    END AS tier_classification
FROM card_metrics
WHERE cmc > 0
ORDER BY viability_rating DESC;

SELECT c.name,
       AVG(c.convertedManaCost) OVER () AS average_converted_mana_cost
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND (
        CASE WHEN c.power GLOB '*[0-9]*' THEN CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) END
      ) >= 5;

votes.sql:
WITH legal_cards AS (
    SELECT c.uuid,
           c.rarity,
           c.power,
           c.convertedManaCost,
           json_extract(c.purchaseUrls, '$.usd') AS price
    FROM cards c
    JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE l.format = 'commander'
      AND l.status = 'Legal'
), with_foreign AS (
    SELECT lc.*
    FROM legal_cards lc
    JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = lc.uuid
    GROUP BY lc.uuid
), with_rulings AS (
    SELECT wf.*, COUNT(r.id) AS rulings_count
    FROM with_foreign wf
    LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = wf.uuid
    GROUP BY wf.uuid
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rarity ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn
    FROM with_rulings
)
SELECT
    price,
    (CASE WHEN power IS NOT NULL
           AND convertedManaCost IS NOT NULL
           AND convertedManaCost <> 0
          THEN CAST(power AS REAL) / convertedManaCost
          ELSE NULL
     END) AS power_to_cmc_ratio,
    rulings_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY rarity, price DESC;

WITH legal_commander_cards AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.rarity, c.edhrecRank,
           COALESCE(c.power, '0') as power,
           COALESCE(c.convertedManaCost, 0) as cmc
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
    WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
),
cards_with_foreign AS (
    SELECT lc.*
    FROM legal_commander_cards lc
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.uuid = lc.uuid)
),
ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) as ruling_count
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT 
    c.name,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.cmc > 0 THEN CAST(c.power AS REAL) / c.cmc
        ELSE 0
    END AS power_to_cmc_ratio,
    COALESCE(r.ruling_count, 0) AS ruling_count
FROM cards_with_foreign c
LEFT JOIN ruling_counts r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT c2.rarity
        FROM cards_with_foreign c2
        WHERE c2.rarity = c.rarity
          AND c2.edhrecRank < c.edhrecRank
    ) < 5
)
ORDER BY c.rarity, c.edhrecRank ASC

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        c.uuid,
        c.convertedManaCost AS price_usd,
        CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(c.power AS REAL) / c.convertedManaCost END AS power_to_cmc_ratio,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rulings r WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid) AS ruling_count,
        c.rarity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.rarity ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC) AS rn
    FROM cards c
    JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid AND l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
    JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
)
SELECT
    price_usd,
    power_to_cmc_ratio,
    ruling_count
FROM filtered
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY rarity, price_usd DESC;

FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND (c.keywords LIKE '%meta-defining%' OR c.keywords LIKE '%format-warping%');

  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND l.format IN ('commander', 'modern', 'legacy', 'vintage', 'pioneer')

FROM "cards"
WHERE "types" LIKE '%Creature%'

       MIN(c.rarity) AS rarity,
